verdicts.threatModel: Tamper of the TFLite FlatBuffer schema text that tools/inspect-mediapipe-image-metadata.py parses; the attacker would need to substitute schema.fbs bytes on the developer's disk or upstream.
verdicts.reachability: Line 47 builds TFLITE_SCHEMA_URL only as a provenance string emitted in the JSON receipt (line 387); the script imports no urllib/requests and never fetches it. The schema is read from a local path and checked against the pinned length (line 352) and TFLITE_SCHEMA_SHA256 (line 45, verified at line 354) before parsing; the URL itself also embeds the commit revision e3388c0b.
verdicts.impact: None: the URL is commit-pinned and never dereferenced by code, and any local schema file whose bytes differ from the pinned SHA-256 is rejected with MetadataError before any parse.
verdicts.rationale: Not a download at all; the referenced schema is pinned by both a git commit in the URL and a SHA-256 enforced at line 354.

verdicts.threatModel: Substitution of schema.fbs consumed by the bounded FlatBuffer reader in tools/inspect-mediapipe-v1.py, a developer-only static inspector of the MediaPipe Face Landmarker bundle.
verdicts.reachability: Line 30 is the first half of the SCHEMA_URL literal (lines 29-32) whose path embeds SCHEMA_REVISION e3388c0b; it is only written into the generated markdown/JSON provenance (lines 613, 643). There is no network call in the file; the local schema is hashed at line 658 and rejected at line 659-660 when it differs from SCHEMA_SHA256 (line 33).
verdicts.impact: None: an attacker-modified schema fails the SHA-256 gate before the reader uses it, and the inspector never executes model content or downloads anything.
verdicts.rationale: The URL is a commit-pinned citation, not a fetch, and the consumed bytes are digest-verified at lines 658-660.

verdicts.threatModel: No downloader at this site: install-sam3.ps1 line 5 is a PowerShell comment telling a developer where to accept the gated SAM License.

verdicts.rationale: Comment text, not a binary download; the rule does not apply.

verdicts.threatModel: A party able to change files on the facebook/sam3 Hugging Face repo's mutable `main` branch (repo owner compromise or HF-side tamper; TLS is in place) alters the tokenizer/config files a Windows developer installs with install-sam3.ps1.
verdicts.reachability: tools/install-sam3.ps1:40 sets $Base to `.../resolve/main` (a mutable branch, not a commit), and line 49 downloads all seven files of $Files (line 19: config.json, vocab.json, merges.txt, tokenizer files) with Invoke-WebRequest; only model.safetensors is checked against $Sha256 (lines 54-60). vocab.json and merges.txt are then consumed by crates/segment/src/tokenizer.rs:46-47 as data.
verdicts.impact: Limited: the 3.4 GB weights are digest-pinned, so code/weights cannot be swapped; tampered vocab.json/merges.txt are parsed by serde_json as plain data and can only degrade Describe-mask tokenization (wrong masks), not execute code. The repo's own crates/segment/src/fetch/mod.rs:17 TODO acknowledges these two files are unpinned. Developer-tool path, not the shipped downloader.
verdicts.rationale: Weights are pinned, but the companion tokenizer files are fetched from a mutable ref without size/SHA-256; pinning a revision or digests would close it. Not an exploitable vulnerability, so recorded as a hardening gap.

verdicts.threatModel: None at this site: tools/install-sam3.ps1:35 throws an error message when no Hugging Face token is configured for the gated facebook/sam3 repo.

verdicts.threatModel: Not applicable: tools/install-sam3.sh:8 is a shell header comment describing the gated license page.

verdicts.threatModel: Someone who can modify the facebook/sam3 repository's `main` branch on Hugging Face (or a --repo the developer names) changes the small tokenizer/config files that install-sam3.sh pulls on macOS/Linux.

verdicts.rationale: Binary weights are pinned, so the rule's binary premise is wrong, but the mutable `main` ref with undigested companion files is a real reproducibility/integrity hardening gap.

verdicts.threatModel: Not applicable: tools/install-sam3.sh:76 echoes guidance to stderr when the HF token is missing.

verdicts.threatModel: None: tools/spectral_camera_table.py:106 is part of the header comment written into the generated crates/raw/src/spectral_table.rs.

verdicts.threatModel: Hypothetical tamper of the rawtoaces-data spectral dataset a maintainer clones by hand before regenerating the colour table.
